_comment: Away / vacation notice. Shows once per visit (per showAgainAfterHours) on the homepage and the inventory page, whichever the visitor lands on first. TO TURN IT ON: set enabled to true, fill in the dates and copy below, commit, let Netlify deploy. It will NOT appear before showFrom or after showUntil even when enabled is true, so it is safe to switch on early and let it schedule itself. Both dates are INCLUSIVE and are read in the visitor's local time.
heading: Cabbage Coins is away
body: I am away from the shop and will not be shipping coins or answering inquiries during this time. The full inventory stays online, so please browse — I will reply to every message in the order it arrived as soon as I am back.
